cars.variant: OPC Nürburgring Edition — 2011 European road reference
cars.specification_market: English Opel release reproduced beneath the 21 April 2011 article. Retain 154 kW and separate 250 Nm normal / 280 Nm overboost, with its 100-octane qualification; no AKI/RON equivalence is inferred. Around 500 was a plan, not a verified final total. Ordinary OPC hardware, later retrospective date/power discrepancies, measured acceleration and a Nürburgring lap-record claim are excluded. One absent Corsa D family is counted.
cars.summary: The Corsa D OPC Nürburgring Edition earned a specific performance identity through a mechanical limited-slip differential, Bilstein chassis and Brembo brakes. First-hand European driving praised traction and usable ride quality: substantial engineering supports this hot hatch’s admission, rather than its circuit badge or body kit.
